# The override directory is deleted when overrides are uninstalled

When you disable a module that contains overrides, then the /override directory is deleted and so an error occurs when trying to install a new override.

## Attendu
Files .htaccess and index.php in /override directory should be preserved

## Étapes
1) Install a module that contains overrides
2) Disable the module
3) Enable the module, you will get the error "Unable to install override: Failed to copy "[...]/override/index.php" because file does not exist."

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
